Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation.
Our orders of part:340010 were placed at 29.89 (po:4500011517-10, 2024-10) and 29.89 EUR (po:4500014436-10, 2026-09).
Our should-cost estimate for part:340010 is 24.31 EUR (cost:340010).
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,400 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your should-cost estimate; however, it does not reflect our manufacturing realities. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

We can accommodate the volume of 23,400 pieces over 24 months with a 56-day lead time. Under these parameters, we propose a revised unit price of €31.70. 

For clarity, our Angebot consists of a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your revised offer. 

In response to your adjustment, we reduce our price to €31.50 per unit for the 56-day lead time. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

For this Angebot, our terms are a price of €31.50 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months.

Please provide the underlying forecasts confirming your volume commitment. Which volume can you commit to? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
